about_the_game: A classic runner is waiting for you, in which you will visit dangerous streets and ordeals. The character is in the territory contaminated with radiation, so in order to survive, you will have to collect an antidote! Pass the strength test and exceed your results to see the whole dangerous world of our game!

  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 (3 GHz or better)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI Radeon 2400 or higher / NVIDIA 8600M or higher / Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard
